niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers clean, spacious interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clearly grouped content, and simplified layouts that reduce clutter. They favor prominent focal elements such as centered icons, large headlines, visible hero imagery, and distinct sectioning. They like soft, polished styling: rounded corners, cohesive iconography, blurred or gradient backgrounds, and accent-driven color themes that feel warm or branded rather than flat or utilitarian. They also prefer CTAs with clear emphasis and thoughtful contrast, especially when integrated into a well-structured composition.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers simplified screens with generous padding, open spacing, fewer visible elements, and reduced crowding.
Prefers layouts with clear focal points, larger headlines or titles, centered key elements, and tightly grouped supporting content.
Prefers information broken into distinct sections, headings, bullets, and organized blocks instead of dense continuous text.
Prefers buttons with strong visual emphasis, clear contrast, and more refined treatment such as bold primary actions paired with differentiated secondary actions.
Prefers softer rounded corners, cohesive icon styling, and visually polished controls over squarer or mixed-style elements.
Prefers blurred, subdued, photographic, or gradient backgrounds that create depth and mood while reducing distraction.
Prefers unified accent palettes and warmer, more inviting brand tones over cooler or more utilitarian color/branding choices.
